svg.title: How the Same GPU Health Rate Produces Different Full-Rack Capacity
svg.desc: The same 92 unavailable GPUs are distributed across 128 NVL72 racks. Concentrated faults leave 126 intact racks; distributed faults leave only 36.
svg.text: Assumption: delivery requires an intact full rack
Orange: rack contains one or more unavailable GPUs
Green: deliverable as an intact NVL72 rack
The healthy count is equal; the deliverable units are not
Health Rate + Failure Distribution + Allocation Shape
